research_addendum_morpho_cbxrp.source_type: Secondary CryptoSlate analysis of Morpho GraphQL position and market data, cross-checked against a public Dune query attributed to @morpho. Not a live current-state capture.

pagination.warning: The source analysis reports pages and position updates across multiple timestamps; do not treat the page walk as one perfectly synchronized snapshot.

cross_date_spot_sensitivity.conditional_interpretation: If the current Morpho oracle tracked the Kraken spot reference and positions were unchanged, the historical 5pct cohort would be beyond its modeled LLTV threshold; the 10pct cohort would not all be beyond threshold. Current oracle, current positions, repayments, top-ups and executed liquidations were not retrieved.

cbxrp_supply_concentration_cross_date.qualification: Cross-date ratio only; not a current market allocation or evidence that all cbXRP supply remained in this market.

coinbase_loan_protection.terms: Protection must be enabled for each loan, applies once, expires after one year, requires available collateral and may be partial or fail; Coinbase says it is not a guarantee against liquidation.
coinbase_loan_protection.cbxrp_specific_eligibility: Not independently established. Morpho market positions may include direct protocol borrowers who are not Coinbase app loan customers.

morpho_api_access_conflict.specific_page_claim: Documents a cursor-paginated GET market positions/health endpoint with LTV filters and indexed-block/ltv-computed timestamps.
morpho_api_access_conflict.general_spec_claim: States that the Core REST spec no longer exposes a market-wide Blue position-health list; GraphQL remains served for existing integrations.
morpho_api_access_conflict.decision: Do not add the positions/health endpoint to scheduled ingestion until a lawful authorized direct request succeeds and current endpoint/authentication terms are reconciled. Do not claim current market-wide position access.

research_addendum_morpho_cbxrp.reason: Historical secondary snapshot; current position state and oracle are absent; page walk is not snapshot-isolated; API documentation conflicts; no raw HTTP bytes or source hashes retained.
